description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Warden of the Eye.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Warden of the Eye with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Warden of the Eye tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
